07-15.solution: B runs at \(\frac{4}{5}\) of A's speed. When A finishes 1000 m, B has run 800 m from its 80 m start, so B is at 880 m and A wins by \(120\) m.

07-34.solution: A takes \(\frac{750}{15} = 50\) s. In 50 s B runs \(12 \times 50 = 600\) m of the 700 m it needs, so A wins by \(100\) m.

07-35.solution: Diametrically opposite points are 400 m apart. Closing at \(16\) m/s they meet after 25 s, when the faster runner has covered \(10 \times 25 = 250\) m from its start.
